chunks: And he said: 'I am going away to my Lord; He will show me the way.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Ibrahim say when he left his people to go to his Lord?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as Ibrahim’s transition from active da'wah to a state of spiritual retreat (khalwah) for deeper communion with the Divine, reflecting the concept of *hady* as both guidance and a path to nearness. It underscores the believer's reliance on God’s direction when leaving behind worldly attachments, a theme resonating with the Ahl al-Bayt’s emphasis on spiritual journeying and divine favor.
